name: Aubergine Kitchen (Orem & Lehi, UT) Signature Açai Smoothie Bowl (Seed & Granola Warning)
whyItWorks: Açai smoothie base topped with crunchy hard granola, chia seeds, flax seeds, and sliced raw strawberries. Hard seeds and dense insoluble oat clusters present a severe stricture obstruction risk.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger warning item: avoid during active disease and strictures. If ordering in remission, ask for no chia seeds, no flax seeds, and sub soft banana slices for crunchy granola.
watchOuts: Chia seeds, flax seeds, and hard granola clusters cause severe mechanical obstruction risks
